newsitem.title: CROATIA: Kuna shortage keeps Croat interbank rates high.
newsitem.headline: Kuna shortage keeps Croat interbank rates high.

text.p: Shortage of kuna kept interbank rates high in Wednesday's mid-morning trade, dealers said.
Most deals were done at a steady call mony rate of 11.0 percent. Long-term loans ranged between 14.0 and 16.0 percent.
Dealers put settlements at 23.2 million kuna by 1030 local (0930 GMT) but strong demand for funds could not be fully met.
They blamed the meagre offer on Tuesday's mandatory reserve payment. Banks were also said to be purchasing Eurokuna bonds issued in December last year.
Overnight trade totalled 118.6 million kuna on Tuesday. It went mostly to one bank's mandatory reserve. -- Metka Jelenc, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
